scope: Shared-sky change built from the current working tree, which also contains independent road and shot-planner changes.
comparison: The new deterministic path freezes cloud drift, producing identical sky pixels across styles. The older r186 baseline still animates its clouds under det=1; before/after brightness measures are captures, not a guarantee of exact cloud-phase alignment.
